$comment: Build Spec §7: named researchers are plotted SEPARATELY from their employers, because
individual published positions often diverge from an institutional house view.
Three rules make this defensible about living people, and this file enforces them structurally
1. CITE PER COORDINATE, not per person. Every placement links the specific piece it came from.
2. DATE EVERY POSITION. People move substantially.
3. LABEL AS “as expressed in X, dated Y”, never “believes”.
Consequence: NO PERSON SHIPS WITH A COORDINATE YET. The roster below is real and sourced,
these are the names Shallow Review 2025 lists against each agenda, but a name against an
agenda is not a position on an axis, and inventing one would be exactly the failure mode rule 3
exists to prevent. Coordinates are all null and the UI renders these as roster entries, not as
points on the plot, until placements land with citation and date.
`pending_placements` is the worklist. It is ordered by leverage: someone who appears against
several agendas routes more traffic than someone who appears against one. See OWNER-DATA.md
source: Shallow Review 2025 `some_names` field, one row per agenda

pending_placements.$comment: The highest-leverage placements to collect first, with the reason each is worth the effort.

priority.why: The spec’s own teaching artifact: the same person argues both poles of the internals axis at different confidence levels, which is more persuasive to a newcomer than any outsider critique. Needs TWO dated placements, not one, the LessWrong research-mindset piece and the 80,000 Hours interview.
sources: Neel Nanda on the mechanistic interpretability researcher mindset (LessWrong)
Neel Nanda on the 80,000 Hours Podcast

priority.why: Named in Additional Context as the paradigm case of a researcher whose published positions are his own rather than his employer’s. Publishes extensively under his own name on exactly the axes with the weakest agenda-level coverage.
sources: The stakes of AI moral status

priority.why: DeepMind house view versus individual view is the second clean divergence case.
Appears against five agendas; high routing leverage.
Appears against five agendas and has published interpretability criticism, so may sit opposite his own field.

pending_placements.rule: A person without a dated citation for an axis gets NO value on that axis, same handling as an org, same handling as a user abstention. Do not impute, do not centre.

correction_path.$comment: Spec §7: “Ship a visible correction path for anyone who thinks their placement is wrong.”
correction_path.label: This placement is wrong
correction_path.note: Owner supplies the address. Rendered on every person profile.
